pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:0.5: ime kho panāyyāyo sattarasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako bhikkhunīsaṅghassa uddositaṃ datvā kālakato hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.4: eko assaddho appasanno eko saddho pasanno,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.6: atha kho so assaddho appasanno saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.8: evaṃ vutte so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etadavoca.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.11: dutiyampi kho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.13: dutiyampi so saddho pasanno taṃ assaddhaṃ appasannaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.16: tatiyampi kho so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.19: sace mayhaṃ bhavissati ahampi bhikkhunisaṅghassa dassāmīti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.22: atha kho so uddosito tehi bhājīyamāno tassa assaddhassa appasannassa pāpuṇi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.23: atha kho so assaddho appasanno bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.25: evaṃ vutte thullanandā bhikkhunī taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.26: “māyyo evaṃ avaca, tumhākaṃ pitunā bhikkhunisaṅghassa dinnoti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.27: dinno na dinnoti vohārike mahāmatte pucchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.30: evaṃ vutte thullanandā bhikkhunī te mahāmatte etadavoca.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.31: apināyyā tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā sakkhiṃ ṭhapayitvā dānaṃ dīyamānanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.33: saccaṃ kho ayyā āhāti taṃ uddositaṃ bhikkhuni saṅghassa akaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.34: atha kho so puriso parājito ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.39: atha kho so puriso daṇḍito bhikkhunūpassayassa avidūre ājīvakaseyyaṃ kārāpetvā ājīvake uyyojesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.44: “paṭhamaṃ bhikkhuniyo uddositaṃ acchindāpesuṃ, dutiyaṃ daṇḍāpesuṃ tatiyaṃ bandhāpesuṃ,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.46: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.47: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.48: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā ussayavādikā viharissatī”ti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.50: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī ussayavādikā viharatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.53: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī ussayavādikā viharissati,
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.55: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:1.56.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ussayavādikā vihareyya gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā dāsena vā kammakarena vā antamaso samaṇaparibbājakenāpi, ayaṃ bhikkhunī paṭhamāpattikaṃ dhammaṃ āpannā nissāraṇīyaṃ saṅghādisesanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.16: bhikkhuñca bhikkhuniñca sikkhamānañca sāmaṇerañca sāmaṇeriñca ṭhapetvā yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.17: aṭṭaṃ karissāmīti dutiyaṃ vā pariyesati gacchati vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.26: saṅghova tassā āpattiyā mānattaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati abbheti, na sambahulā na ekā bhikkhunī, tena vuccati saṅghādisesoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-ss1:2.1.27: tassa ceva āpattinikāyassa nāmakammaṃ adhivacanaṃ tenapi vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
